results.step: warehouse admin approves a request with an edited quantity
results.detail: MRR-2026-00018 Pending Approval->Approved; shipment MSH-2026-00020 Pending

results.step: the shipment carries the EDITED quantity, not the requested one
the linked Material Request is submitted with the approved quantities
the shipment is wired to the request / MR / transit warehouse
results.detail: req=MRR-2026-00018 mr=MAT-MR-2026-00005 from=HOU-WH - CCZ transit=OK-JENKS In Transit - CCZ to=OK-JENKS - CCZ

results.step: the request records approved_by / approved_at and links the shipment
the store manager is notified that the request was approved
approving an already-approved request is refused and creates no second shipment
results.detail: 417 frappe.exceptions.ValidationError: Request MRR-2026-00018 is Approved; shipments for MRR-2026-00018: 1

results.step: rejecting an already-approved request is refused
a line approved at 0 is dropped from the shipment
the zeroed line is removed from the submitted Material Request too
rejecting without a reason is refused
results.detail: 417 frappe.exceptions.ValidationError: A rejection reason is required

results.step: warehouse admin rejects a request with a reason
results.detail: MRR-2026-00022 -> Rejected: "QA2 discontinued — order the 20K instead"

results.step: rejecting deletes the draft Material Request (nothing left half-open)
the store manager is notified of the rejection, with the reason
results.detail: [{"for_user":"warehouse@cloudchaserz.example","subject":"OK-JENKS requests 7 unit(s) from the warehouse"},{"for_user":"ok.jenks.manager@cloudchaserz.example","subject":"Replenishment MRR-2026-00022 rejected: QA2 discontinued — order the 20K instead"}]

results.step: a rejected request creates no shipment
the rejected request shows on the store's Receive feed with the reason
approving MORE than the warehouse holds is accepted (no stock check at approval)
the request line shows the warehouse on-hand so the admin can see the shortfall
